evidence_kind: Codex-authored actual official-tool off-policy coldstart demonstrations
latest_user_scope: Prepare questions/data only; training deferred. Preview of F1/F3/F4 120 only; F2/F5 pending. Official prompts/format deferred (no format/normalize full run).
notes: Read-only reuse of prepare_f_course.py validation (excluded repos, specialist submechanisms, disjointness) + course-manifest.template.json schema/policy. No writes to acquisition/replay/S600; no format/normalize run. Family/snapshot groupings retained, not random evaluation splits.
